question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word'** Disclosed**’ in the given sentence and choose the correct option.

The linguist’s analysis of the language revealed patterns and structures that were previously unknown.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. **Revealed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is "**disclosed**", which means made known or revealed. (प्रकट किया).

 
 
• **Example:** The company disclosed its new strategy to the board.
 
 
 
• The correct word "**Revealed**" closely matches "**disclosed**" in meaning, referring to the act of making something known or visible that was previously secret or hidden.(प्रकट किया).
 
 
• **Example:** The magician revealed the secret behind his trick.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3 i.e. **Revealed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Linguist (भाषाविद): **A person skilled in foreign languages or the scientific study of language.

 
 
• **Example:** The linguist was able to translate the ancient manuscript.
 
 
 
• **Patterns (पैटर्न):** A repeated decorative design or a regular and intelligible form or sequence discernible in certain actions or situations.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist used colorful patterns in her paintings.
 
 
 
• **Unknown (अज्ञात): **Not known or familiar.
 
 
• **Example:** The unknown soldier was finally identified years later.
